topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't believe it. We've been inseparable since childhood, through every laugh and tear, every first and every struggle. Now, everything feels like it's falling apart. It’s not just a house that’s moving, it’s my heart, my history, my home away from home. I keep thinking about all the things we said we'd do together—like finishing that novel we started, or finally taking that trip to the coast. The future we planned together is slipping through my fingers like sand. I just don’t know how things will be the same with miles and miles between us. I guess all I can do is try to hold on to the moments we have left and find a new way to keep our friendship alive.
